# ARC Ideation

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

The stages for the natural flow of ideas in the creative process (Add, Related, Communicate).

**Also known as:** ARC Framework

## Scope note

- Frameworks and methodology recommended by Nick Milo and Linking Your Thinking (LYT) for linked note systems like Obsidian.

## Broader

- [Ideaverse](../Ideaverse/)
